# standards-dist

> Distributable projections of the WyattAu standards: two agent skills
> (engineering + spec) and a read-only MCP server exposing the estate
> gates. Projections per SC-11/11p; canons own truth.

- skills/spec-standards: SPEC-CORE authoring/adoption skill + gate scripts
- skills/engineering-standards: OMNI-CORE scaffold/tier/audit skill
- mcp/standards_mcp.py: doc_lint, spec_audit, conformance_checklist, estate_status
- build.sh: rebuild + freshness check (--check)
